ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.3 Playtest is a compatibility-first performance and multithreading runtime for RimWorld 1.5. It includes a bounded worker pool, main-thread dispatch, automatic Harmony conflict fallback, circuit breakers, safe text/UI scan caches, and an optional short-lived reachability miss cache. Invasive Pawn/Thing/Reservation parallel ticking remains disabled for mod compatibility.
